name: ShenZhen YUTO Packaging Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: ShenZhen YUTO Packaging Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides packaging solutions in China and internationally. The company offers wine and spirits packaging solutions, such as plant fiber inner tray for wine packaging, leather-like specialty paper, photolithographic printing, PU leather and flocking high-end solution, anti-counterfeiting locking mechanism solution, wood-like specialty paper, and lenticular enhancement solution.
